annotations.title: Look up a domain's registry record

description: Registry record for one domain: registrar, registration and expiry dates, nameservers, status codes, and whether it appears to be for sale. Resolves the correct registry host for the extension itself, and reads RDAP for .dev, .app and other extensions whose operators publish no port-43 whois service. Use when asked who owns a domain, when it expires, or where it is hosted. It forces a registry lookup, so it is also the only call that fills offer — a taken domain that appears to be parked or listed for sale. An offer is an inference from nameservers and a listing page, never a quote: the asking price lives on the listing and not in the registry, so link the listing rather than naming a figure.
name: whois
title: Look up a domain's registry record
